svg.title: Ze's AI management system over time: rules, specifications and le tooling
svg.desc: Two aligned daily timelines from 19 December 2025 to 27 November 2026. Top: AI rules lines rise to a peak of 71,916 on 8 August when split into one-point-per-file directives, then drop to 22,360 on 30 August after condensing into CORE.md and TRIGGERS.md, holding near 27,000 through November. Bottom: specifications under plan/ grow to 471,000 lines (peaking at 498,000), and the compiled Go tooling under internal/le/ launches on 25 August and grows to 865,000 lines.
svg.text: THE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM OVER TIME · RULES, SPECS AND LE TOOLING
Rules were condensed into a router while specs and le scaled up
Split into one-point files in Aug (71.9K peak), then condensed into CORE.md + TRIGGERS.md (27.3K today)
Daily agent-rules and plan/ lines from website/data/repo-history.json through 27 Nov 2026; internal/le/ Go lines sampled from 25 Aug through 27 Nov 2026.
